title: Doubting oneself and waiting on God
summary: Brother James says he has exhausted human means; Mahalia tells him to wait on the Lord.

story.theme_name: Starting the tape: names, dates and places
story.community_name: Interview openings: names, dates and tape setup

blocks.x: It isn't the point of doubting God, Mahaya, it's the point of doubting oneself. Well... One doesn't doubt God because... Oh, then you are doubting yourself. That's right. God is sure, and his promises are sure. But man... But why you can't believe that his promises are sure? His promises are sure. Why? Why you don't believe? Even Christ, when he was on earth, came to his promise.
Even if you doubted yourself, why doubt God? Why would you have your feelings that you got now?

I've exhausted all human means to correct myself, to correct my condition, and friends have failed, and institutions have failed me. I don't know what to do. Well, God hasn't failed you. I go down on my knees. It doesn't matter if everybody... I should have used it as a first resort instead of the last resort. Anyway, I have tried. God knows that I have tried.

Then, as I said this morning, man's extremity is God's opportunity. You have to just wait on the Lord. You can't hurt him. I think you're too... You want things done fast. You don't have... If a man doesn't have patience to wait on God, surely he doesn't have patience to wait on his fellow man. God doesn't have to wait on him. God doesn't have to wait on him. Yes. . . .
